AuthoringOptions.description: Approved vocabularies for the editor: nothing outside these lists is accepted by the server.
AuthoringOptions.title: AuthoringOptions

IntakeCallbackRequest.description: The verification obligation as the source requested it: due date and priority are source-provided.
IntakeCallbackRequest.title: IntakeCallbackRequest

IntakeParty.description:
Either an existing synthetic party (``party_ref``) or a new one (``kind`` + ``name``). Parties are never
matched on name or contact value.
IntakeParty.title: IntakeParty

IntakeReference.description: Values the intake API accepts, read from the same sources the validator uses (no new rules).
IntakeReference.title: IntakeReference

IntakeSourceRisk.description: SBQ callback-selection risk exactly as the source assigned it. Call360 calculates no band or score.
IntakeSourceRisk.title: IntakeSourceRisk

OneTimePassword.description: Returned once to the administrator; never stored in plain text, logged or audited.
OneTimePassword.title: OneTimePassword

RecordingNotice.description: S1-C test-only recording notice (D-45). Not approved AIA/MAS consent wording.
RecordingNotice.title: RecordingNotice

RecordingTimeline.description:
Recording time ↔ playback mapping for both tracks (samples at ``sample_rate``). The evidence WAV holds stored
chunks only; gaps are timeline spans, never filled audio.
RecordingTimeline.title: RecordingTimeline

RecordingTrack.description: One recorded track's manifest metadata (EVD-003). Never an object key or storage path.
RecordingTrack.title: RecordingTrack

ReviewEvidence.description: What the finding points at, as recorded. Absent media is stated, never implied.
ReviewEvidence.title: ReviewEvidence

SessionMedia.description:
API-046 from S1-C: the session's recording evidence. ``availability`` is the derived evidence vocabulary
(EXT-002): AVAILABLE (audio stored and you may retrieve it), RESTRICTED (stored, but your role lacks
``recording.read``), NOT_AVAILABLE (not recorded, purged or no capture), FAILED (consent granted, nothing
stored).
SessionMedia.title: SessionMedia

SessionTranscript.description:
API-045 from S1-D: transcript status, provenance and counts (no text) for any reader of the case. ``status``
maps to the approved ``conversation_session.transcript_status``: PENDING/PROCESSING → PENDING, COMPLETE →
FINALIZED (QUALITY_FLAGGED when uncertain speech is present), PARTIAL → PARTIAL, FAILED/UNAVAILABLE →
UNAVAILABLE. COMPLETE means every stored track was processed over complete recording coverage; it never means
correct, reviewed or certified (``review_status`` is always NOT_REVIEWED in S1).
SessionTranscript.title: SessionTranscript

TranscriptRun.description: One transcription of one stored track with its full provenance (D-49). Immutable once DONE or FAILED.
TranscriptRun.title: TranscriptRun

TranscriptSegmentOut.description:
One recognised (SPEECH) or rejected (UNRECOGNIZED, never with text) stretch of one track. Times are on the
session recording timeline; ``wav_offset_ms`` is the position in that track's evidence WAV.
TranscriptSegmentOut.title: TranscriptSegmentOut

VoiceSessionOut.description:
A short-lived, case-bound test session (S1-A; persisted from S1-B). ``session_id`` is the persisted browser
contact attempt. The credential is single-use and expires quickly; it is sent as the first WebSocket message,
never in a URL.
VoiceSessionOut.title: VoiceSessionOut

Queue a new transcription revision for each track whose latest run FAILED. Idempotent: tracks that are
queued, processing or done are left alone. The failed revision stays as it is.
